reason: Provides DSH agents with fast Windows filename and optional content search through the Everything index, plus backend status reporting; the README clearly establishes a file-search utility as its primary purpose.

summaries.zh: 通过 Windows 上的 Everything 索引为 DSH 智能体提供快速的文件名及可选文件内容搜索，并报告后端状态。
summaries.en: Provides DSH agents with fast Windows filename and optional file-content search through the Everything index, along with backend status reporting.

capabilities: Search indexed Windows filenames and optionally file contents through Everything
Scope searches to an absolute Windows path
Report Everything backend availability and executable location
Invoke the local es.exe command-line interface
